reports.relief: Recover INR 4,50,000 (and related s.138 relief as pleaded)

limbs.label: Legally enforceable debt + dishonoured cheque + compliant statutory notice
limbs.why: All four links score high; VI is low. This is the control case for a healthy limb.

where_argument_needs_more_strength.action: Pre-empt a bare denial of service of notice by organizing ACK + tracking printout in a single exhibit set.
Keep a one-page checklist of s.138 elements with exhibit cross-refs so the bench sees no missing statutory step.

pedagogy.learning_objective: See a clean Argument Tree where min(links) is high and Missing Links is empty.
compare_with: demo_03_hard_partition — law and exposure both fail

reports.relief: Compensation for unpaid bonus and wrongful / discriminatory termination

limbs.label: Bonus became a non-discretionary earned wage once performance conditions were met
limbs.why: Narrative is plausible, but Evidence is the bottleneck (42). Law is also soft (55) because offer letter says discretionary.

where_argument_needs_more_strength.action: Obtain Finance records that FY2023 targets were met; subpoena bonus board minutes; collect peer bonus payouts as pattern evidence.
Research teaching jurisdiction cases on when 'discretionary' bonuses become wages; prepare alternative quantum meruit theory with clear elements checklist.
Lock down base salary figure and exact bonus % math in a one-page damages spreadsheet tied to offer letter.

limbs.label: Termination was age discrimination, not true reorganization
limbs.why: Law path exists (72) but Evidence (38) cannot currently prove pretext or animus. This limb should top Missing Links.

where_argument_needs_more_strength.action: Discovery: who was hired/reassigned into Cole's duties; age composition of reduction-in-force; any age-related remarks; comparator performance files.
Interview Jordan Hale and peers; timeline of restructuring decision relative to performance review.
Prepare for after-acquired evidence and mitigation defenses; document plaintiff's job search for back-pay math.

pedagogy.learning_objective: Two limbs; Evidence gaps dominate VI; do not let a good story outrun the file.

reports.relief: Preliminary decree for partition (1/2) and related declarations

limbs.label: Property is HUF / ancestral; plaintiffs entitled to half on partition
limbs.why: Fact of acquisition is clear, but HUF character is not proven. Law and Exposure both suffer.

where_argument_needs_more_strength.action: Build authority map for when property in karta/father's name is HUF vs self-acquired; plead and prove nucleus with accounts if any.
Model defendant exclusive-title counterclaim and adverse possession; prepare limitation clock analysis year-by-year from 1998/2010/2012/2023.
Gather family genealogy, other estate assets, tax/electricity patterns, witness affidavits of joint family status.

limbs.label: 1998 oral family settlement crystallized Kavita's half share
limbs.why: This is the intentional collapse limb. Evidence 22 and Law 28 drag VI to ~78. Do not lead with this limb until fortified.

where_argument_needs_more_strength.action: Find any contemporaneous letter, diary, panchayat note, or conduct (e.g., contribution to construction) that corroborates settlement; without it, de-emphasize limb.
If oral arrangement cannot be saved, reframe as pure inheritance/partition rights independent of 1998 story — do not rest the case on unprovable oral gift/settlement.
Stop using approximate '1998-04' unless a witness pins a better date; vague dates invite adverse inference.
Anticipate estoppel/waiver arguments from long silence (1998–2023); document any demands made earlier.

limbs.label: 2008 gift deed is void (undue influence / forgery / not binding on coparceners)
limbs.why: You cannot beat a registered deed with suspicion alone. Evidence 30 is the choke point; Exposure includes limitation risk.

where_argument_needs_more_strength.action: Commission handwriting/medical capacity evidence; examine attesting witnesses; obtain original deed production.
Prepare limitation reply: when cause of action for declaration arose; knowledge pleadings must be particularized.
Separate void vs voidable theories; plead particulars of undue influence; map who can challenge a gift of alleged HUF property.

pedagogy.learning_objective: Multi-limb tree where the emotionally attractive oral-settlement limb is the integrity disaster. Scorer should surface L2 as weakest (VI ~78).
pedagogy.strategy_note: Lead with improved L1 (HUF/partition) only after evidence; treat L2 as optional/abandoned until corroborated; L3 requires forensics before trial emphasis.
